4.604.203.title: Tablero con Viga de Hormigón Postensado de un Tramo 11,0 m ≤ L ≤ 15,0 m, Geometría y Cables Viga Postensada

viga_postensada.section_view: Corte C-C (lámina 4.604.203); Corte D-D confirms the 2,5 cm typical soffit chamfers
geometry_notes: Every outline dimension is printed (Corte C-C plus the Geometría table); the outline is a polygonal I: top flange a1 x 15, 5 x 5 cm 45° fillets into the web e, web, a 10 cm straight taper from e to a2, bulb sides h4, 2,5 x 2,5 cm chamfers at both soffit corners ('tip. 2,5', Corte D-D).
The top-flange underside is flat for (a1 - e)/2 - 5 cm each side before the 5 x 5 fillet (derived from the chain, not printed separately).

CONVENTION: the top face carries the deck crossfall p% ('80 al eje', i.e. depth 80 cm on the beam axis). It is modelled horizontal at 80 cm; p is project-specific (Nota 5: bombeo o peralte según proyecto vial).
Midspan section (Corte C-C). The 200 cm solid end blocks (Cortes A-A, B-B) and the 60 cm transitions are excluded.

Ten table rows give eight distinct outlines: C10-L12 is identical to C8-L11 and C10-L13 to C8-L12 (they differ only in cables). Only the eight distinct outlines are counted in SIZES; the two duplicates are accepted as aliases.

Sheet 4.604.201 Nota: 'Vigas postensadas se pueden reemplazar por diseño con vigas pretensadas (de fábrica)'. Beam concrete H-40, deck slab 23 cm H-30; 3 beams at 390 cm (calzada 8,0 m con pasillo, 1180 cm deck) or 340 cm (calzada 10,0 m, 1080 cm deck).
No section properties or concrete volumes are published for this beam (lámina 4.604.205 is passive-steel take-off only), so no property check is possible.

losa_nervada.section_view: 'SECCIÓN VIGA' (lámina 4.604.001): 25 top, 20 bottom, 70 deep; 'Viga prefabricada: Hormigón H-30'

published.note: Lámina 4.604.003 'Cubicación 1 viga'. Volume / L reproduces A = 0.1575 m2 for all five lengths (beam length = L).

geometry_notes: Plain trapezoidal precast RC rib, all three dimensions printed; no chamfers drawn. Plan note 'var. 20 a 25' is the taper seen in plan.

Ribs at 75 cm (one 80 cm bay at the centreline; urbano o rural, 1160 cm deck, 16 ribs) or 74 cm (rural, 1060 cm deck, 15 ribs), with a 17 cm cast-in-place slab. Nota 14: the design permits prefabrication of the beams (planta o pie de obra).

residuals.A_from_volume_rel: max |dV|/V = 0.23% (L = 14 m: 2.205 vs 2.21) over L = 11-15 m (volumes printed to 0.01 m3)
